title: Radix sort
description:
Sort numbers digit by digit without comparing them.

```
input:  170 45 75 90 802 24 2 66
by 1s:  170 90 802 2 24 45 75 66
by 10s: 802 2 24 45 66 170 75 90
by 100s: 2 24 45 66 75 90 170 802
```
hints: Count each digit `(x / place) % 10`, turn the counts into starting positions, then place items in order into a new vector (lesson 3.05).
Stability (equal digits keep their order) is what makes the next pass keep the earlier work.
requirements: A stable counting sort on one decimal digit, used for each digit from the lowest.
Print the array after each digit.
Works for non-negative numbers of any size.
stretch: Sort strings of equal length the same way, character by character.
